title: Special Drug Use Surveillance of Irribow in Female Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of the survey is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of Irribow and Irribow OD Tablets in post-marketing medical practice and to examine the status of treatment compliance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female patients with diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Female patients with diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome
